name: code-digger-agent
title: Code Digger
description: Digs out dead code: unused classes, methods, functions, variables, imports and files. Proves each piece is dead with tests, removes it, and keeps the suite green.

name: presto-performance-agent
title: Presto Performance
description: Hunts slow code: missing DB indexes, N+1 queries, missing pagination, poor algorithms and data structures, missing caching, heavy images. Measures before and after every fix.

name: migration-bot-agent
title: Migration Bot
description: Bumps dependencies to their latest versions and performs the code migrations the bumps require, with the full test suite run before and after.

name: test-automator-agent
title: Test Automator
description: Adds the tests that matter: core logic, property based, integration, stress, chaos, contract, CSS and UI tests. No duplicates, no tests of frameworks or the language.

name: worm-doccer
title: Worm Doccer
description: Reads README, docs, performance.md, backlog.md and design-doc.md, compares them with the code, and brings every drifted document back in sync using the code as the source of truth.

name: bug-hunter
title: Bug Hunter
description: Hunts real bugs, writes bug-report.md, and fixes each one with TDD: a failing test first, then the fix, then the green suite.
